items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: I’ll tell you a good book is Jackie McLean’s book you know.

ctx.x: Because like man I’m here working like a dog right now man, you know, I mean trying to figure out all different kinds of ways to memorize things more quickly and so on, and then sometimes I get so wrapped up in the stuff and I forget the stuff that I’m working on you know so then I’ll be playing — “Oh I used to play that, I used to play this, I used to do this, I used to do that.” So and then I’m pulling all that back out you know, so that I’m doing that. Because I’m working on memory you know and trying to — so,…
